verdict.rationale: LanceDB exposes a well-documented, multi-language API (Python, JS/TS, Rust) with concrete code examples for search, filtering, indexing, embeddings, versioning, and table management, plus an llms.txt for AI-native consumption. Missing for 10: a formal OpenAPI/REST spec (probe shows 404s on openapi.json/swagger.json) and independent developer corroboration beyond one mixed HN comment on docs quality.
